limitations.note: The patch fixed the combinational feedback in the ring register but made reset synchronous and exposed the rotated bit directly, rather than asynchronously resetting a registered output that captures the pre-rotation bit.

The test required the output to stay high until a clock edge after reset assertion and counted the first bit before the first post-reset rising edge, so it validated the patch's assumptions instead of catching the reset and output-phase mismatches.
The targeted lookup returned only a truncated transcript fragment and provided no useful guidance on reset or output timing.
